intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Orbit is a personal habit tracking app. We take your privacy seriously and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we store, how we use it, and your rights under the LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados) and equivalent data-protection laws.

controller.title: Who Controls Your Data
controller.body: The data controller is TL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING LTDA (CNPJ 58.429.979/0001-06), the company that operates Orbit. For privacy requests or questions, contact our data protection lead at contact@useorbit.org.

dataCollected.title: Data We Store
dataCollected.account: Account information: name and email address (via email signup, Google OAuth, or Sign in with Apple)
dataCollected.habits: Habit data: habits you create, completion logs, schedules, tags, and goals
dataCollected.chat: AI chat messages: conversations with the Orbit AI assistant
dataCollected.preferences: Preferences: language, timezone, color scheme, and notification settings
dataCollected.device: Device data: a push notification token (to deliver reminders) and Android crash reports with device and OS details, a random installation ID, and an approximate city inferred from the request IP address. These reports do not include your name, email, or account details.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.provide: To provide and operate the Orbit service
howWeUse.personalize: To personalize your experience with AI-powered insights and summaries
howWeUse.notifications: To send push notifications and habit reminders you have configured

thirdParty.notion: Notion: read-only access to titles, dates and status of the pages you share, so Astra can suggest tasks and habits. Orbit stores these records in its database hosted by Render in Ohio, United States. Disconnecting deletes the connection and all stored Notion records.
thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We use the following services to operate Orbit:
thirdParty.google: Google OAuth: for sign-in directly with Google
thirdParty.firebase: Firebase Cloud Messaging: for push notifications
thirdParty.openai: OpenAI: for AI chat features and daily summaries
thirdParty.ses: Amazon SES (us-east-2): for transactional and marketing emails
thirdParty.googlePlay: Google Play Billing: for subscription purchases on Android
thirdParty.apple: Apple: for Sign in with Apple and subscription purchases through the App Store
thirdParty.sentry: Sentry: for crash and error reports. On Android, these include device and OS details, a random installation ID, and an approximate city inferred from the request IP address, without your name, email, or account details
thirdParty.posthog: PostHog (US Cloud): for product analytics linked to an account identifier and plan details, plus web traffic and performance analytics; we do not send habit or chat content
thirdParty.render: Render (Ohio, United States): for web and API hosting and the database
thirdParty.turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile: for bot protection during sign-in

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.essential: The web app uses auth_token and refresh_token cookies to keep you signed in. Cookies and browser storage also remember preferences such as language and theme. The public website saves your analytics choice in local storage (orbit_analytics_consent), including when you decline.
cookies.analytics: On the public website, optional PostHog analytics use cookies and browser storage only after you select Allow. They measure page views, page exits, and clicks on links to the web app or Google Play. A browser identifier can be shared with the web app and linked to your account if you sign in. Session recording is disabled.
cookies.withdraw: To withdraw consent for the public website, close its open tabs, clear cookies and site data for useorbit.org and its subdomains in your browser settings, then return and select Decline. This also removes shared analytics identifiers and signs you out of the web app.

noSell.title: We Do Not Sell Your Data
noSell.body: Your data is not sold to third parties and is not used to train AI models. Your habit data and conversations are used solely to provide you with the Orbit service.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: All connections to Orbit use HTTPS encryption. Authentication uses rotating refresh sessions. Payment information is handled entirely by Stripe and never touches our servers.

retention.notion: Notion: shared page records and encrypted connection credentials are kept while connected. Disconnecting deletes everything Orbit stored from Notion.
retention.title: How Long We Keep Your Data
retention.intro: We retain your data only as long as needed to provide the service:
retention.account: Account data: kept for as long as your account is active.
retention.sessions: Authentication sessions and push tokens: kept while active and removed on logout, token expiry, or device unsubscribe.
retention.ai: AI chat history: kept while AI features are enabled and removed when you delete your account.
retention.reminderHistory: Sent reminder, slip alert, and streak freeze records: kept for 90 days from the record date.
retention.syncRecords: Records deleted for offline sync: kept for 31 days before permanent removal.
retention.calendarSuggestions: Google Calendar import suggestions that you do not import: kept for 14 days.
retention.billingRecords: Operational request and billing records: processed requests and Google Play billing notifications are kept for 30 days; processed Stripe webhook events are kept for 90 days.
retention.afterDeletion: Account deletion: personal data is permanently erased 7 days after confirmation, or 7 days after the end of the current paid period, whichever is later, except where the law requires limited records.

googleScopes.title: Google Account & Calendar Access
googleScopes.intro: If you connect Google, we request only the scopes needed for the features you use:
googleScopes.auth: Basic profile and email, to create and identify your account.
googleScopes.calendar: Read access to your Google Calendar events, used solely to show events alongside your habits and to suggest imports.
googleScopes.control: We never expose raw Google event payloads to the AI, and you can disconnect Google at any time, which deletes the stored access and refresh tokens.

dataResidency.title: Where Your Data Is Stored
dataResidency.body: Render hosts the web application, API, and database in Ohio, United States. Orbit uses Amazon SES for transactional and marketing emails and Amazon S3 for file uploads in us-east-2 (Ohio, United States). PostHog processes product, web traffic, and performance analytics in its US Cloud. Other processors, including OpenAI, Stripe, Google, and Cloudflare Turnstile, may process data outside Brazil. International transfers to these providers rely on the safeguards the LGPD allows for international transfers, including contractual commitments from each provider.

automatedProcessing.title: AI & Automated Processing
automatedProcessing.body: Orbit's AI assistant, Astra, processes your habit and chat data to generate summaries, retrospectives, and suggestions. This is assistive only and does not make legally significant decisions about you. You can disable AI summaries at any time in Profile, and you may object to automated processing by contacting us.

minors.title: Age Requirement
minors.body: Orbit is not directed to children. You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. If we learn that we have collected data from a child under 13 without appropriate consent, we will delete it.

export.title: Your Right to Export Your Data
export.body: You can download a copy of all your Orbit data (habits, logs, goals, tags, and settings) as a JSON file from the Profile page, in line with your data-portability rights under LGPD Art. 18.

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.body: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from the Profile page in the app. The process requires email confirmation:
deletion.step1: 1. Go to Profile and select "Delete account"
deletion.step2: 2. A confirmation code will be sent to your email
deletion.step3: 3. Enter the code to confirm deletion
deletion.step4: 7 days after confirmation, or 7 days after the end of your current paid period, whichever is later, all data is permanently deleted, including habits, completion history, AI conversations, and settings. This action is irreversible.

wizard.calendarDescription: Already have events in Google Calendar? Import them as habits in Orbit with one tap.
wizard.importDescription: Coming from another habit tracker? Astra can recreate your habits. Attach a file or paste your list.

habitsSection.creatingDesc: Tap the + button at the bottom of the screen, or ask the AI in chat. Set a name, optional description, and frequency schedule (daily, weekly on specific days, monthly, or yearly).
habitsSection.frequenciesDesc: Habits can repeat daily, on certain days of the week, monthly, or yearly. You can also set a habit for one day.
habitsSection.subHabitsDesc: Break down complex habits into smaller steps. For example, 'Morning Routine' can have 'Meditate', 'Journal', and 'Stretch' as sub-habits. Each can be completed independently.
habitsSection.checklistsDesc: Add a checklist to a habit for things like shopping or packing. Check items off in the detail view. The checklist resets when you log a habit that repeats. You can save checklists as templates.
habitsSection.loggingDesc: Tap the circle next to any habit to mark it as done. Tap again to undo. You can also log habits through the AI chat by saying things like 'I ran today'.
habitsSection.badHabitsDesc: A habit you want to avoid, like smoking or nail biting. Log each slip. Your streak counts days without slips.
habitsSection.slipAlertsDesc: Enable slip alerts on bad habits to receive AI-generated motivational notifications before your usual slip times. The system detects day and time patterns from your logs and sends personalized nudges to help you stay strong.
habitsSection.metricsDesc: Each habit tracks your current streak, best streak, weekly and monthly completion rates, and total completions. Tap a habit to see its full stats.
habitsSection.dragDropDesc: Press and hold any habit card to drag it into your preferred order. Your custom order is saved automatically.
habitsSection.bulkSelectDesc: Tap 'Select' to enter selection mode. Choose multiple habits to log, skip, or delete them at once.
habitsSection.filteringDesc: Find habits by name with search. Use the chips below it to filter by daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or once.
habitsSection.summaryDesc: When enabled in Settings, an AI-generated summary card appears at the top of your Today view with insights about your day and motivational nudges.
habitsSection.remindersDesc: Add reminders to any habit. Habits with a due time get relative reminders (e.g. 15 min before). Habits without a due time get scheduled reminders at specific times on the same day or day before. You'll receive a push notification for each reminder.
habitsSection.duplicateDesc: Long-press a habit card or use its menu to duplicate it with all settings (frequency, tags, reminders). Great for creating similar habits quickly.
habitsSection.dateNavDesc: Use the left and right arrows on the Today view to navigate between days. The Today view also shows any overdue habits that still need attention.
habitsSection.endDatesDesc: Set an optional end date for a habit that repeats. It stops appearing in your schedule after that day.
habitsSection.goalLinkingDesc: Link habits to your goals from the habit form. Linked habits contribute to goal adherence tracking, helping you see how your daily actions drive progress toward bigger objectives.
habitsSection.tagDisplayDesc: Tags you assign to habits appear as color-coded badges directly on habit cards. Quickly identify categories at a glance without opening each habit.
habitsSection.skipDesc: Skip marks a habit as intentionally skipped for the day without breaking your streak. Use it when you consciously chose not to do a habit (rest day, travel, etc.) rather than simply forgetting.

progressSection.goalsDesc: Create a goal from a habit or ask Astra, then find it in Progress with your streak, figures, and achievements.
progressSection.trackingDesc: Open a goal to see notes and progress history. Update standard goals manually; streak goals follow linked habit logs.
progressSection.linkingDesc: Connect habits to goals for adherence tracking. See how consistently you follow through on the habits that matter most for each goal.
progressSection.aiReviewDesc: Get AI-generated reviews of your goal progress with analysis of what's working, what needs attention, and suggestions for staying on track.
progressSection.statusDesc: Goals move through active, completed, and abandoned states. Mark goals as completed when you hit your target, or abandon them if priorities change.

astraSection.canDoDesc: Tell Astra what habits you want and it creates them. Say 'I ran today' to log one. You can also ask for a habit on a single day, like 'buy eggs tomorrow'.
astraSection.toolsBreadthDesc: Astra does more than chat. It can act. It has 63 tools spanning habits, sub-habits, goals, tags, checklists, logging, reminders, calendar, and your account, so almost anything you can do by tapping, you can do by asking. The free plan includes 5 AI messages a day; Pro includes 250 a week.
astraSection.manageDesc: Ask Astra to modify habits: 'move my gym to tomorrow', 'rename running to jogging', 'change meditation to weekly', or 'delete my reading habit'. It can handle bulk operations too.
astraSection.insightsDesc: Ask 'how am I doing?' and Astra analyzes your real streaks, completion rates, and trends. It can give weekly reviews, suggest improvements, and celebrate your progress.
astraSection.reschedulingDesc: Ask Astra to analyze your schedule and suggest better times or days for your habits. It considers your existing routine to find optimal slots. Pro feature.
astraSection.imageDesc: Send a photo of a schedule, to-do list, or calendar and Astra extracts habits from it. It suggests them for your review before creating anything.
astraSection.voiceDesc: Tap the microphone icon to speak instead of type. Choose your language from the flag picker next to the mic. Supports multiple languages.
astraSection.cannotDoDesc: Astra is focused on habits and routines. It can't answer general knowledge questions, help with homework, or do things unrelated to your habits.
astraSection.tipsDesc: Astra remembers your conversation, so you can say 'modify the previous suggestion' or 'change TestA to weekly'. It also knows your streaks and stats, so ask for honest feedback.

connectSection.mcpDesc: Connect an MCP-compatible assistant to Orbit and use it where you already work.
connectSection.assistantCanDoDesc: The connection has 81 tools across 15 areas, including habits, goals, tags, checklists, reminders, and progress.
connectSection.apiKeysDesc: Create a scoped API key in Profile after a fresh sign-in. Choose read-only or full access, and revoke it whenever you need.
connectSection.setupDesc: Copy Orbit's MCP endpoint and one API key from Profile into your MCP client.

calendarSection.dayDetailsDesc: Tap any day on the calendar to see which habits were scheduled and their completion status.
calendarSection.navigationDesc: Use the arrows to move between months. Tap the search icon to jump back to the current month.
calendarSection.streaksDesc: The calendar shows your completion patterns over time. Use it to identify consistency gaps and see which days you tend to miss, so you can adjust your routine.
calendarSection.googleCalendarDesc: Import events from your Google Calendar. Meetings and appointments appear in Orbit on the right day.

rewardsSection.xpLevelsDesc: Logging habits earns XP, and your level rises as the XP adds up.
rewardsSection.achievementsDesc: Achievements are grouped by category in Progress.
rewardsSection.streaksDesc: Progress shows your current streak and the days that build it.
rewardsSection.streakFreezeDesc: Orbit banks a freeze as your streak grows. You choose to spend one to repair yesterday.
rewardsSection.wrappedDesc: Orbit Wrapped turns a finished period into a recap you can review and share.
rewardsSection.milestoneShareDesc: When you reach a streak or achievement milestone, you can share its card outside Orbit.
rewardsSection.referralsDesc: Your personal invite link lives in Profile. Share it when you want to invite someone to Orbit.

remindersSection.bellDesc: The bell opens everything Orbit sends you: reminders that fired, streak and level updates, friend activity, calendar results, and goal deadlines. Its badge counts the unread ones.
remindersSection.managingDesc: Mark reminders as read or delete them one at a time. You can also mark all as read or delete all.
remindersSection.configuringRemindersDesc: Set one or more reminders on the habit. Use its time or choose a fixed clock time.

widgetSection.todayDesc: The Android widget shows today's habits. When nothing is scheduled today, it shows tomorrow's habits instead.
widgetSection.opensDesc: The widget never logs a habit. A tap anywhere on it opens Orbit, and refresh only updates the widget.

intro.title: How to Delete Your Orbit Account
intro.body: You can permanently delete your Orbit account and all associated data at any time. You do not need to be signed in on this page to learn how. Deletion is available directly inside the app and by email request.

inApp.title: Delete From Inside the App
inApp.intro: The fastest way to delete your account is from the app:
inApp.step1: 1. Open Orbit and go to the Profile tab.
inApp.step3: 3. We email you a 6-digit confirmation code.
inApp.step4: 4. Enter the code to confirm. Your account is deactivated immediately.

grace.title: 7-Day Grace Period
grace.body: After you confirm deletion, your account is deactivated right away and permanently deleted after a 7-day grace period. Signing in again within those 7 days reactivates your account and cancels the deletion.

webFallback.title: Request Deletion by Email
webFallback.body: If you can no longer access the app, email contact@useorbit.org from the address associated with your account and ask us to delete it. We will verify your identity and process the request.

data.title: What Gets Deleted
data.body: Deletion removes your habits, completion history, goals, tags, AI conversations, settings, and account profile. This action is irreversible once the grace period ends.
